purposes.seed: Repeatable modelling variation; independent of gameplay random numbers.
purposes.oak_body_radius_m: Fits the lower wood within the existing 0.7 m square in every yaw, leaving 2 cm margin.
purposes.oak_body_height_m: The existing three-metre native trunk body; upper canopy is overhead presentation.
purposes.oak_crown_start_m: Keep large branches above the native trunk body and player head.
purposes.oak_crown_spread_m: End the smooth lower-trunk fitting transition here, retaining broad irregular overhead branches.
purposes.oak_upper_lean_m_per_m: Lean upper wood and attached crown together while the work target stays inside its native body.
purposes.oak_notch_depth_m: Physical dark chopping wound exposed by partial native work, without magical emission.
purposes.clay_size_blender_m: Fit soft earth inside the unchanged 1.8 by 0.38 by 1.25 m native Godot body.
purposes.clay_scoop_depth_m: Visible excavated depth accumulated across six actual four-unit clay releases.
purposes.reed_height_m: Mature seed heads stay within the native 1.3 m picking envelope, including restrained wind.
purposes.reed_stalks: Dense upright harvest silhouette divided into four equal groups matching six-unit releases.
purposes.reed_horizontal_scale: Leaves and stalks shrink together by five percent horizontally, preserving a wind margin inside the one-metre native body.
purposes.sedge_height_m: Low splayed decorative leaves remain distinct from upright harvestable seed heads.
purposes.tree_lod_m: Near, middle and far transitions in this small review, not a world shipping budget.
purposes.small_lod_m: Retain foreground roots and foliage while reducing distant local ground detail.
purposes.wind_period_s: Slow ambient rooted motion, paused explicitly by the review clock.
purposes.wind_m_per_m: Small sway proportional to rooted height; ground contact remains stationary.
purposes.plant_seating_fade_m: Only low stem vertices follow retained review terrain; mature seed heads preserve the native height envelope. Native flat-floor presentation applies no seating.
purposes.clay_seated_top_m: Cap seated review soil at the existing body top; downhill soil follows the bank and uphill excess is buried. No geography or body changes.
